hero.subtitle: Manufacturers, processors and wholesale suppliers of Kota Stone, Indian Marble, Granite, Sandstone and Exterior Cladding — for homes, architects, builders and developers across India.
hero.note: 100% natural stone · Precision cut · Calibrated & polished

intro.body1: Pushp Narayan Stone Supplier is dedicated to supplying premium-grade building stones directly from quarry and processing hubs in Rajasthan to homeowners, architects, builders, contractors and commercial developers across India.
intro.body2: With direct sourcing relationships, modern cutting and calibration infrastructure, and strict multi-stage quality grading, we ensure uniform colour tones, accurate dimensions and damage-free doorstep delivery — for projects of every scale, from single residential homes to large industrial warehouses and townships.
intro.caption: Rajasthan · India

collections.subtitle: Five comprehensive ranges covering interior flooring, heavy-duty industrial floors, outdoor parking, staircases, countertops and architectural wall cladding.

featured.subtitle: A cross-section of our most requested varieties — every lot graded for shade and dimension before it leaves the yard.

applications.subtitle: From quiet interior floors to driveways that carry vehicles all day — matched finishes, thicknesses and grades for every duty.

process.subtitle: Four controlled stages between the Rajasthan quarry and your site — each one measured, inspected and documented.
